hooks.name: Unit tests on Python save
hooks.description: Esegue gli unit test del servizio quando si salva un file .py sotto services/<svc>-service/

action.command: python -c "import json,sys,subprocess,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get('filePath') or d.get('path') or '').replace(chr(92),'/'); m=re.search(r'services/([^/]+-service)/',p); sys.exit(0) if not m else None; svc=p[:m.end()-1]; print('Running unit tests for',svc); subprocess.run(['python','-m','pytest','tests/unit','-q','--cov=app','--cov-report=term-missing'],cwd=svc); sys.exit(0)"
